scope: Every Clio report by category, dashboards (firm, personal, accounting), AI/insights reporting, custom reports, presets, scheduling, history, exports and report permissions; compared with platform.json reports, report-catalogue, custom-report-builder, firm-insights and trust/billing reports.

features.name: Accounts receivable report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Billing
features.what: Outstanding amounts on approved unpaid and past-due bills per user, client and matter; reflects partial payments, interest and credit notes; drafts excluded.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Accounts receivable aging report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Billing
features.what: Overdue receivables bucketed 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 91+ days past the bill due date, for collection follow-up.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Billing history report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Billing
features.what: Bills open, paid and past due with status, due date, payments, credit notes, interest and balance.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Matter balance summary report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Billing
features.what: Per matter: receivables, unbilled work in progress and expenses in progress; optionally client and matter trust funds. Columns can be hidden/reordered.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Invoice payments report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Billing
features.what: Bill payments and Clio Payments refunds, how each payment was allocated to bill line items (incl. overpayments) and the users responsible for those lines.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Forex gains and losses report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Billing
features.what: For multi-currency firms: gain or loss from the rate at bill issue vs. rate at payment, with currency totals.
features.plan_tier: firms using multiple currencies

features.name: Client activity report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Billed and unbilled time and expense entries across a client's matters (non-billable time excluded).
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Client ledger report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Per client trust and operating transactions: payments, refunds, transfers and balances.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Trust ledger report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Client and matter transactions and balances across all trust accounts; Clio positions it as suitable for regulators.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Trust interest calculation report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Computes interest earned on client/matter trust funds from a rate, compounding period and date range.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Trust management report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Unbilled time and expenses vs. trust balance and the minimum trust threshold per matter, to see where retainers are running low. Also used to carry trust balances into a migration.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Trust listing report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Summary of trust balances for all clients with opening and closing balances.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Work in progress report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Unbilled time and expenses per matter: entries on draft or pending-approval bills or not on any bill.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Bank account activity report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Client
features.what: Funds in and out across all firm bank accounts (operating and trust) with running balance.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Matters report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Matter
features.what: Matter list with description, responsible and originating attorney, last bill date, AR, billable flag, practice area, status and client contact details.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Matters by responsible attorney report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Matter
features.what: Matters grouped by responsible attorney with client name and description.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Contact information report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Matter
features.what: Clients, their matters and basic contact details; suggested for building an email list.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Billing rate report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Matter
features.what: Custom and default client, matter and user billing rates across matters.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Productivity by client report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Productivity
features.what: Amount billed per client and each client's share of firm billings (approved or paid bills).
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Productivity by user report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Productivity
features.what: Per user time and expense split into unbilled (draft/pending bills), billed and total, incl. discounts.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Matter productivity by user report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Productivity
features.what: Each user's billed, unbilled and non-billable time and expenses grouped by matter.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Realization report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Productivity
features.what: Per user progression of time from original value through discounts/write-offs to billed and collected.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Revenue report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Revenue
features.what: Unbilled, billed and collected time and expenses by matter incl. taxes, credit notes, discounts and interest; results depend on creation vs. billing date.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Originating attorney revenue report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Revenue
features.what: Revenue brought in per originating attorney incl. taxes, interest and collected time and expenses.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Fee allocation report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Revenue
features.what: Per user and matter: billed and collected time and expenses, AR and credit notes, to work out compensation splits.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Task progress by user report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Task
features.what: Per user task counts by status (pending, in progress, in review, completed) with time estimates.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Task productivity by user report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Task
features.what: Per user counts of upcoming, overdue and completed tasks.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Clio Payments monthly statements
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Online payments
features.what: Monthly statement of all online payments for bookkeeping and tax.
features.plan_tier: firms using Clio Payments

features.name: Clio Payments ledger report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Online payments
features.what: All payment-processor transactions by type and status (charges, fees, refunds, disputes, payouts).
features.plan_tier: firms using Clio Payments

features.name: Clio Payments transaction report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Online payments
features.what: Authorized payment transactions with processing fees.
features.plan_tier: firms using Clio Payments

features.name: Clio Payments deposit report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Online payments
features.what: Deposits (payouts) with the matching transaction fees, daily and monthly.
features.plan_tier: firms using Clio Payments

features.name: Form 1099-K report
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Online payments
features.what: US IRS settlement report for card processing volume.
features.plan_tier: US firms using Clio Payments

features.name: Personal injury reports (damages, medical expenses, medical expense payments)
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Reports > category Personal injury
features.what: Damages and medical bills recorded on a matter; medical expenses by provider with liens and balances; payments by payer.
features.plan_tier: firms using PI matter features

features.name: Law Society of Alberta trust report (Trust Safety Accounting Upload)
features.where: Reports > Reports > category Compliance
features.what: Alberta-specific annual trust filing output; enabled by default when the account mailing address is in Canada; cannot be preset or scheduled.
features.plan_tier: Canadian accounts (Alberta use)

features.name: Trust account management reports (Australia)
features.where: Reports (AU accounts)
features.what: Jurisdiction-specific trust compliance reports incl. a file maintenance report of changes to contacts, matters and bank accounts; only for accounts set to Australia.
features.plan_tier: Australian accounts only

features.name: Trust reconciliation report
features.where: Accounts > trust account > Reconciliations > View report
features.what: Per completed reconciliation: summary (ledger vs bank and difference), transaction details (in/out, interest, charges, adjustments, cleared and uncleared) and per-client ledger effect; PDF export; kept 10 years.
features.plan_tier: current plans only; admins reconcile

features.name: Report output formats and column chooser
features.where: Classic report > Output format
features.what: Most reports output CSV and PDF; some Excel and Web. For CSV on 11 named reports, columns can be hidden, shown and reordered.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Report presets
features.where: Reports > Classic reports > Presets
features.what: Save a report plus filters as a named preset; generate, edit or delete. Presets are private to their creator; not available for 1099-K, Clio Payments statements and Alberta compliance reports.
features.plan_tier: US Core/Signature/Elite; CA Essentials/Advanced/Complete

features.name: Scheduled presets
features.where: Save as preset > Add schedule
features.what: Daily, weekly (chosen days) or monthly (every 1-12 months) at a set time with an 'effective from' date; result emailed to the creator; schedules run for up to 12 months.
features.plan_tier: US Core/Signature/Elite; CA Essentials/Advanced/Complete

features.name: Report history
features.where: Reports > History
features.what: Own report runs from the last six months; sort, filter by category/output/date, search by name, reopen in original format. Users cannot see others' runs.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Custom reports (Reports Beta)
features.where: Reports > Reports Beta > Create new custom report
features.what: Pick a dataset, fields and calculations with live sample preview; name, description, category; refine with columns, filters (unlimited, default last month), up to two group-by levels and currency. Filtering/grouping only on standard fields, not custom fields. Still labelled Beta.
features.plan_tier: create: US Signature/Elite, CA Advanced/Expand; others can refine Clio pre-built reports

features.name: Custom report datasets
features.where: Reports Beta > dataset picker
features.what: Account transactions (operating+trust), Bills, Calendar entries, Fee allocation, Online payments, Matters, Payments and credit notes, Time entry productivity; most include matter/contact standard and some custom fields (not contact-select, matter-select or multi-line text).
features.plan_tier: as custom reports

features.name: Report views
features.where: Reports Beta > report > Save report view
features.what: Saved refinement (columns, filters, groups) of a custom or Clio report; per-report subtabs Report (key-metric summary, columns, filters, groups), Report views, History of exports with who/when/format and re-download.
features.plan_tier: unlimited on US Signature/Elite, CA Advanced/Expand; 5 per Clio report on US Core / CA Essentials

features.name: Scheduled report views
features.where: Reports Beta > Report views > Add schedule
features.what: Daily/weekly/monthly with time, start date, format and recipients; higher tiers can notify other firm users, lower tiers self only.
features.plan_tier: US Core+, CA Essentials+ (others-notify on US Signature/Elite, CA Advanced/Expand)

features.name: Duplicate and customize
features.where: Reports Beta > card > More
features.what: Copy any existing (incl. Clio pre-built) report as the base of a new custom report; edit, export or delete.
features.plan_tier: as custom reports

features.name: AI report building (Manage AI)
features.where: Reports Beta > Manage AI prompt; AI Launchpad > Ask a question
features.what: Describe a report in plain language and the AI preselects dataset fields and calculations; ask the Launchpad to run a standard report for a period or answer personal-metric questions (billed hours, realization, collection, utilization).
features.plan_tier: firms with Clio's AI features (Manage AI add-on)

features.name: Firm Dashboard
features.where: Dashboard > Firm Dashboard
features.what: Utilization (vs 8-hour day), realization (billed minus discounted over billable hours) and collection rates by year, by activity date; date selector, user filter, currency picker. Visible to admins and users with reports permission.
features.plan_tier: all current plans (reports permission)

features.name: Industry benchmarks on dashboard (Legal Trends Report)
features.where: Dashboard (marketing claim)
features.what: Marketing says firms can compare their metrics against Legal Trends Report benchmarks; not described in the help article.
features.plan_tier: unknown

features.name: Personal Dashboard
features.where: Dashboard > Personal Dashboard
features.what: Today's agenda, hourly metrics (billable vs target), firm billing metrics by bill state, financial metrics vs annual target (260-day year) and the detailed annual report.
features.plan_tier: all; billing panels need billing+reports permission

features.name: Detailed annual report and personal performance targets
features.where: Settings > Profile > Personal Performance; Dashboard > Personal Dashboard
features.what: User sets rate, annual billing target, working days and fiscal year end; chart compares target vs actual billable time.
features.plan_tier: all (billing+reports permission)

features.name: Firm Feed
features.where: Dashboard > Firm Feed
features.what: Firm-wide audit stream of record changes (matters, contacts, payments, bills, time, permissions, documents) filterable by user, type and deleted/exported. Admin-only by default; custom role can grant it.
features.plan_tier: all; custom roles on higher tiers

features.name: Reports permission (all or nothing)
features.where: Settings > Manage Users > Permissions > Reports
features.what: One checkbox grants every report; reports cannot be restricted individually and expose colleagues' productivity and rates even without billing permission.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Reports payment allocation setting
features.where: Settings > Billing > Reports allocation
features.what: Admin picks how partial payments and credit notes are spread over line items (proportional, or expenses/services oldest-first variants); affects invoice payments, fee allocation, revenue, originating revenue and the dashboard collection rate.
features.plan_tier: all current plans with Reports permission (Clio says not every report is on every plan; per-report tiers not published)

features.name: Bulk data export
features.where: Exports page (app.clio.com/export / ca.app.clio.com/export)
features.what: Admin-only Excel-ready CSV per type: calendar entries, communications, contact notes, contact related matters, contacts, expense entries, matter notes, matters, tasks, time entries. Balances come from the AR and trust management reports, not the exporter.
features.plan_tier: all; admins only

features.name: Reports API (report presets)
features.where: API v4 /report_presets, /report_presets/{id}/generate_report
features.what: List, create, update, delete presets and generate a report from a preset via API.
features.plan_tier: API access

features.name: Clio Accounting reports
features.where: Clio Accounting > Reports
features.what: Profit and loss, general ledger, balance sheet, trial balance, cash flow, operating/trust reconciliation, vendor expenses, and (Canada) a tax summary laid out by sales-tax return line numbers incl. input tax credits.
features.plan_tier: plans that include Clio Accounting

features.name: Accounting dashboard
features.where: Clio Accounting > Dashboard
features.what: Account balances with bank-feed items to review, AR total and paid/owing invoice counts, monthly operating expenses vs prior month, hard costs to invoice, two-month P&L, best-practice checklists.
features.plan_tier: plans that include Clio Accounting

features.name: Clio Grow reports
features.where: Clio Grow > Reports
features.what: Matter revenue by lead source, campaign and referral; lead source revenue; matters added with pipeline value and conversion rate; referral report of referring contacts. Admin permission needed.
features.plan_tier: Clio Grow

features.name: Third-party analytics add-ons
features.where: Clio App Directory
features.what: Apps such as LawKPIs add read-only dashboards with peer benchmarks (realization, AR aging, utilization, intake conversion).
features.plan_tier: third-party

gaps.feature: Trust management report (WIP vs trust balance vs minimum trust threshold)
gaps.proposal: Add catalogue row Trust > 'Retainer coverage': per matter unbilled WIP + AR vs trust held vs the matter's minimum trust / evergreen threshold, with 'top-up needed' flag; agent drafts the replenishment request (human sends).

gaps.feature: Trust interest calculation report
gaps.proposal: Add Trust > 'Trust interest' for separate interest-bearing trust accounts only: rate, compounding, period, allocation per client; note mixed trust interest goes to LFO, not clients (verify).

gaps.feature: Bank account activity report (all firm accounts)
gaps.proposal: Add Money > 'Bank account activity': funds in/out and running balance per general and trust account, sourced from ledgers, with bank-feed match status.

gaps.feature: Reports payment allocation setting
gaps.proposal: Add firm setting 'payment allocation for reports' (proportional | disbursements first | fees first, oldest first) with effective date; every money report and the collection KPI shows which method it used; changing it never rewrites past runs.

gaps.feature: Fee allocation settings (originating/responsible/staff percentages)
gaps.proposal: Add firm and per-matter credit split (originating %, responsible %, staff %) and a Money > 'Fee credit allocation' report that applies it to collected fees.

gaps.feature: Structured schedule (daily/weekly/monthly, effective-from date, expiry)
gaps.proposal: Replace free-text 'schedule' with fields cadence (daily|weekly days|monthly every N), time, start date, end date (default 12 months), format, internal recipients; renewal reminder before expiry.

gaps.feature: Report views and per-report export history
gaps.proposal: Add 'views' (saved column/filter/group variants of any report, incl. catalogue reports) and per-report History tab (who exported, when, format, re-download); 'Duplicate and customize' action on catalogue reports.

gaps.feature: Custom report datasets: calendar entries, fee allocation, online payments, payments and credit notes
gaps.proposal: Extend dataset enum with calendar events, credit notes, fee credit allocation and online payment transactions; allow filter/group on custom fields (Clio cannot).

gaps.feature: Column chooser (hide/show/reorder) on standard reports
gaps.proposal: Add 'columns' option on every catalogue report run, remembered in presets.

gaps.feature: Online payments reports (deposit/payout, monthly statement, ledger)
gaps.proposal: Split 'Online payment transactions' into: processor ledger (charges, fees, refunds, disputes, payouts), deposit/payout report matched to bank deposits, monthly processor statement.

gaps.feature: Forex gains and losses
gaps.proposal: CAD-only firm assumption; if multi-currency is added later, add Money > 'Foreign exchange gain/loss'. Record the assumption in the spec.

gaps.feature: Personal injury reports (damages, medical expenses and payments, liens)
gaps.proposal: If PI is a supported practice area: add Matters > 'Damages and medical specials' and 'Liens and subrogation' reports fed by a matter damages schedule.

gaps.feature: Personal dashboard and personal performance targets
gaps.proposal: Add a 'My numbers' panel on the home screen: billable vs target hours, fiscal year end, working days, billed/unbilled; targets set by the user or admin (firm-insights already has targets).

gaps.feature: Firm Dashboard utilization/realization/collection
gaps.proposal: Add explicit definitions matching ours (available hours basis, activity-date vs bill-date) and show which basis is used.

gaps.feature: Legal Trends benchmarks
gaps.proposal: Keep external benchmarks out; optionally allow a firm-entered target band.

gaps.feature: Firm Feed (firm-wide change log with deleted/exported filter)
gaps.proposal: Confirm the audit view covers human edits (not only agent events) and add filters 'deleted' and 'exported'; access via role permission.

gaps.feature: Per-report permissions
gaps.proposal: Ours is stronger (per-report role visibility vs Clio's single all-reports permission). Add to versus page.

gaps.feature: AI report building and Ask a question
gaps.proposal: Ours already shows query and rows; add example prompts for personal metrics (my realization last quarter).

gaps.feature: Accounting reports (P&L, GL, balance sheet, trial balance, cash flow, vendor expenses)
gaps.proposal: State in spec that the general books live in the connected accounting system; keep exports to it. Add 'HST return worksheet' mapping our HST report to GST/HST return lines incl. ITCs from recorded disbursements (verify CRA line numbers).

gaps.feature: Clio Grow reports: revenue by lead source/campaign, pipeline value, referral report
gaps.proposal: Add Intake > 'Revenue by lead source' (collected fees traced to lead source/campaign), 'Pipeline value' (expected value of open leads), 'Referrers' (referring contacts with matter counts and fees).

gaps.feature: Bulk CSV export by data type
gaps.proposal: Ours is broader (bills, payments, trust ledgers, audit hash). Add communications and contact-matter relationships to export_entities to match Clio.

gaps.feature: Reports API (presets, generate report)
gaps.proposal: Add API endpoints: list catalogue, run report with filters, fetch run output, manage presets; same role visibility and export logging.

gaps.feature: Reconciliation report retention 10 years, 3 sections, PDF
gaps.proposal: Confirm our monthly reconciliation output has the three parts (summary, transaction detail incl. uncleared, per-client effect).

gaps.feature: Alberta-style jurisdiction compliance output
gaps.proposal: Ours targets LSO; Clio only ships Alberta. Highlight on versus page (verify Clio has no Ontario-specific report).

corrections.our_claim: platform.json clio_gaps: 'Trust reports (journal, ledger, listing, dormant)' at 'Reports > Trust / Accounts'
corrections.truth: In Clio Manage (non-AU), trust reports sit in the Client category: client ledger, trust ledger, trust interest calculation, trust management, trust listing. No help article found for a dormant/unclaimed trust report or separate receipts/disbursements journals. A dedicated 'Trust reports' article exists only for Australian accounts.

corrections.our_claim: platform.json clio_gaps: 'Custom reports' at 'Reports > Custom reports'
corrections.truth: Custom reports live under Reports > Reports Beta, are still labelled Beta, and creating them needs US Signature/Elite or CA Advanced/Expand. Filter and group work only on standard fields, not custom fields.

corrections.our_claim: platform.json clio_gaps: 'Firm dashboard / insights with benchmarks' at 'Insights / Firm dashboard'
corrections.truth: It is Dashboard > Firm Dashboard with three metrics (utilization, realization, collection) by activity date. The benchmark comparison appears only in marketing, not in the help article. There is no separate 'Insights' screen.

corrections.our_claim: platform.json clio_gaps: 'Data export to CSV per data type' at 'Settings > Data export'
corrections.truth: It is a separate Exports page (app.clio.com/export), admin-only, with ten types (calendar entries, communications, contact notes, contact related matters, contacts, expenses, matter notes, matters, tasks, time). It does not cover bills or trust ledgers; balances come from reports.

corrections.our_claim: platform.json clio_gaps: 'Scheduled reports' marked 'already covered' by reports 'schedule' (free text)
corrections.truth: Clio schedules are structured (daily/weekly/monthly every 1-12, time, effective-from date, max 12 months, email notice; report views add format and other-user recipients on higher tiers). Our free-text field is only partial coverage.

corrections.our_claim: platform.json clio_gaps: 'Classic reports with filters' at 'Reports > Reports'
corrections.truth: Path is Reports > Classic reports > Reports subtab > Categories (Billing, Client, Matter, Productivity, Revenue, Task, Online payments, Personal injury, Compliance).
